scope: C8 bounded authenticated endpoint event handling and receiver cached Reply replay; automatic timer retry and reconnect/resume remain disabled

after_source: Pin reviewed C8 source and executable hashes before measurement

host.machine: wick, shared Linux x86_64 host; existing bounded Cargo target; fresh process per cell
host.harness: unchanged Rust broker_objects; two local TCP roles sharing one broker, not native MVM or WAN
host.cells: raw-mixed, whole-mixed, combined-cpu at requested 1 MiB, trials 0/1/2; whole-mixed and combined-cpu at requested 16 MiB, trial 0; before/after each cell, reverse order for trial 1
host.ceilings: One active cell, existing Rust 512 MiB owned-store and 1 GiB sampled process-RSS ceilings, 30-minute entire batch deadline; no retained payload on success
host.required: All eight target bytes and original lengths exact, durable publication and independent readback, two-way envelope/framing counters match; record setup, thread/process CPU, verified transfer and cleanup/lifecycle, peak process RSS, and every regression
host.interpretation: Exploratory paired comparison on a shared host; fixed large trial and three small trials do not establish a causal or statistically qualified speedup

native.cells: Reviewed before and after source, whole-mixed and combined-cpu, stage two, requested 16 MiB, trial 0; one cell at a time
native.ceilings: At most two guests, each 1 vCPU and 1 GiB RAM, no guest NIC; existing 256 MiB writable disk per cell; 30-minute entire batch deadline; temporary owned runner only
native.required: Exact publications and stopped-store keyless readbacks, bidirectional and two-hop counters, sender/receiver CPU and setup/lifecycle, relay CPU/resource snapshots, joined teardown; current canonical AcceptedEphemeral remains distinct from durable object commit
native.network_scope: Local native boundary only; experimental64 Linux rate enforcement remains absent, no WAN claim

custody: Retain compact source/binary identities, public receipts and failed gates in GitHub; checksum archives/members before removing only successful owned remote payload stores. No VM disk, payload dataset or new Cargo target on Mac.
